query: I was walking my golden retriever this morning and he chased a squirrel right into a patch of dandelions, got his fur all full of the fluffy seed heads, and I had to stop and pick them out for 10 minutes before I could get in my car to run errands. Then I stopped by the new coffee shop on Oak Street and tried their lavender honey latte, it was so sweet and creamy I even grabbed a second one to bring home to my roommate. We also just started watching that new fantasy miniseries last night, the costumes are so detailed I keep pausing the show just to look at all the embroidery on the character's gowns. Anyway, I'm having some issues with my phone right now: my wifi calling is really bad, my APN MMS settings seem to be broken, I think the SMS permission for my messaging app isn't working properly either, and I also got a notification that I've exceeded my data usage limit, can you help me fix these?
